### CONCAT
Concatenates two or more strings.

Note: The result can be at most 1MB long. For a longer one, `CONCAT` returns `null` and emits a warning.

```esql
FROM employees
| KEEP first_name, last_name
| EVAL fullname = CONCAT(first_name, " ", last_name)
```
